reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests the car pulling forward out of the dark, so the action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is supplied, and the audio reference does not govern visual rendering, so the request owns the visual medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference or observed wardrobe is supplied to retain, so wardrobe resolves to the request-governed visual description.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies lighting authority; the brief’s darkness is part of the requested scene, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference supplies framing authority; the car’s movement alone does not specify a camera composition, but with no reference the request owns framing.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies color or tonal grading authority, so palette is request-governed rather than reference-governed.
